raised: Calculator shows you put in 70,000 but are left with 68,270 in today's money after tax, and the page never says plainly that you lose buying power
No deposit insurance in Israel is alarming, and the page doesn't say how likely a collapse is or what to do
Key line at the top (123 מקור/מחושב/הזנתה) is confusing; 'הזנתה' is meaningless
Terms like 'השבירה ותחנות היציאה' and 'סוגי פיקדון מקובלים' needed the glossary
Did not understand 'העוגן' (the anchor) in the bank-rate line
Optional age field is puzzling: why would age matter for a deposit?
Example product terms (Leumi, 12 months) were cut off at the bottom of the screen
Jargon in 'למה משתמשים בזה': קרנות כספיות, מק"מ, מוצרי שוק הכסף, and the 'מזומן שקלי' button
'שווה לדעת' is only titles with codes and nothing behind them
Only saw the end of 'מי מציע ומי מפקח'
'כסף נכנס ויוצא' only says something obvious
'כמה זה עולה' gives no actual cost, just 'per the bank's price list'
Site doesn't calculate breaking a deposit early, which is exactly what the reader fears
Risks section jumped, so only its first and last lines were seen
Glossary is very long and seemed to appear twice
Chart's teal area is a straight line that tells little
Thin pinkish line on the chart is unexplained
The promised dotted line for an entered rate wasn't visible
Purple dotted underlines are unexplained
'חוקים וכללים' column in the cost table is empty
Glossary 'איפה מופיע' column is useless
Grey code tags (TXI-03, BANK-06...) are noise and should go
Did not understand the prime rate or how it moves
Unclear how to actually open a closed-system account
Unclear what 'real' interest (25% of real interest) means in shekels
Unclear whether the rule on offsetting securities losses applies
No rate given for an indexed deposit
No example in shekels of the real penalty for breaking early
No information on how risky one's bank is or whether to split money between banks
No lump-sum example without monthly deposits
No side-by-side comparison of current bank rates
No comparison with leaving money as-is or with a money-market fund
'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' looks like it's for checkers and could be dropped
Repeated 'הצגת החוקים והכללים' links should be removed

problems.why: The reader only asks why age matters for a deposit at all; they never say that age, linkage or term fail to change the graph, so the person's problem isn't named.
